Ahmed Ali's War of Liberation
2021-12-09T23:30:37+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/ahmed-alis-war-liberation-2913931

Ahmed Ali, a young freedom fighter of 20 years, came forward in 1971 to help the freedom fighters. Numerous freedom fighters have been sheltered in his house, and he also gave information about the Pakistan Army and Razakar Al-Badr to freedom fighters. After training in India in August 1971, he joined the front line.

Today's Star Special has the story of the wartime struggle of freedom fighter Ahmed Ali in 50 years of victory
